summary.short: Creates a right in individuals' voice and visual likeness against unauthorized digital replicas, makes unauthorized replicas and replica-producing products actionable in civil suits, and sets notice-and-takedown rules for online services; effective 180 days after enactment.
summary.long: H.R. 8915 (NO FAKES Act of 2026) gives individuals and right holders the right to authorize use of their voice or visual likeness in a digital replica (a newly created, highly realistic computer-generated representation) or in a product or service. The right is a property right, not assignable during life, and lasts up to 70 years after death; lifetime licences must be written, signed and limited to 10 years (5 for minors, with court approval). Anyone who makes available an unauthorized digital replica, or distributes a product primarily designed to produce one, is liable in a civil action, with exclusions for bona fide news, commentary, parody and similar uses. Online services avoid liability by registering a designated agent with the Copyright Office and following notice-and-takedown procedures. Remedies include statutory or actual damages, injunctions and punitive damages for willful conduct. Effective 180 days after enactment; liability covers only later conduct.

notes: Introduced text (IH), 20 May 2026, referred to the Committee on the Judiciary; this annotation covers only that text. The bill makes no amendment to an existing statute and states no legal basis; its references to other U.S. Code titles are listed under relations with null registry IDs. No material internal inconsistency found. Statutory damages in sec. 2(e)(4)(A) and (B) vary by actor category, and the $750,000 figure appears with different wording in sec. 2(e)(4)(A)(i)(I)(cc) (a ceiling) and sec. 2(e)(4)(A)(ii)(I)(cc) (a per-product amount). Liability applies only to post-enactment conduct (sec. 2(j)(1)); the bill takes effect 180 days after enactment (sec. 2(k)). Section status for relations is set to not_applicable only to satisfy the schema, since entries are present.
